run_annotation_tool_A_multi_agent: run the annotation_tool_A_multi_agent script to print an MTurk XML HTMLQuestion for the multi-agent annotation interface
render_q_from_main: run the main block to render Q_ACTION and Q_ACTION_LOOP questions as HTML fieldsets via render_q
generate_mturk_html_question: generate the full MTurk HTMLQuestion XML output with Bootstrap styling and tooltip JavaScript for command annotation
customize_before_template: modify the BEFORE string constant to change the MTurk annotation instructions and example content
customize_after_template: modify the AFTER string constant to change the MTurk annotation page footer CSS and script includes
